about: The sessions corpus (tracks/llm/sessions_corpus.py): 120 Green Bank observing sessions drawn at random (seed 20261108) from the 1164 in bldata.berkeley.edu's pipeline index with a Hipparcos or Gliese target and not drawn before (60 excluded), one on-target fine-resolution scan each. From each scan: up to `hits` on-target hits (family stars) and `blind` blind windows (family blind-window), 64 channels by 16 time steps, as the Live Lab's pool cuts them.
